reasons.label: Different entity, same or similar name
reasons.guidance: Verified as a distinct legal entity: different registration, incorporation date or ownership. State the evidence.

reasons.label: Different individual
reasons.guidance: Same or similar personal name, demonstrably a different person.

reasons.label: Date of birth does not match
reasons.guidance: Partner's UBO or director date of birth conflicts with the designation. Only valid where a reliable DOB was obtained.

reasons.label: Country or nationality does not match
reasons.guidance: Use with care: a designated party can operate through a third country, so country alone is weak grounds. Record what corroborates it.

reasons.label: Registration or national ID does not match
reasons.guidance: Tax ID, passport or company number conflicts with the designation.

reasons.label: Common name coincidence
reasons.guidance: The matched name is common in the market and no other identifier corroborates the designation.

reasons.label: Partial name overlap only
reasons.guidance: Only a generic or fragmentary element matched, not the distinguishing part of the name.

reasons.label: Designation is a vessel, aircraft or other non-counterparty
reasons.guidance: The designation is not a party we can contract with.

reasons.label: Designation delisted or measure expired
reasons.guidance: Verified against the current regulator publication. Record the date checked — a delisting can be reversed.

reasons.label: Confirmed: partner is the designated party
reasons.guidance: Identity corroborated on more than name alone. Escalate immediately.

reasons.label: Confirmed: designated party owns or controls the partner
reasons.guidance: The 50%-or-more / control test is met via a designated UBO or parent.

reasons.label: Inconclusive — further diligence required
reasons.guidance: Identity could not be resolved with available data. State what is outstanding and who is chasing it.

reasons.label: Other (explain in the rationale)
reasons.guidance: Use only where nothing above fits. A rationale is mandatory.
